sentence: This project establishes a manufacturing approach for mixing solid particles into liquid metals for soft robotics and stretchable electronics.
This project studies how a protein protects telomere DNA from being degraded and what other proteins act with it.
This project develops a super-resolution imaging technique for cells and tissues that uses specimen movement.
This project works on algorithms and theory in areas such as computational geometry, randomized algorithms and data structures.
This project studies how tissue properties of the cervix change in cervical dysplasia and builds a computational model of transport through abnormal cervical tissue.
This project studies the power and limitations of graph neural networks and builds learning methods for wireless networks and power grids.
This project builds computer science curricula in areas such as cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data science.
This project supports sharing research on systems security, network security, software security and hardware security.
This project develops a terahertz imaging radar system for contactless concealed weapons detection.
This project develops a modular topological quantum computing platform, a type of quantum computer.
This project shares applied research on effective teaching and learning in cybersecurity.
This project develops a toolbox for separating macromolecules based on the gas-phase mobilities of aligned ions.
This project studies how small particles melt and how the molten material flows and mixes, using experiments in a microgravity environment.
This project develops methods to evaluate and certify the positional quality of geospatial data.
This project develops efficient quantum algorithms to simulate condensed phase quantum dynamics on quantum computers.
This project uses photoacoustic imaging to guide treatment catheters to the heart with robotic assistance and to visualize nerves.
This project develops cross electrophile coupling reactions to make peptide natural products.
This project develops Bayesian methods for making predictions from generative models in a statistically valid way.
